assessments.name: Reliability and Validity Reliability can be divided into three categories: test-retest, internal, and inter-rater.
rubricLanguage: Experiments, tests, and measurements must also be valid.
For example, different patients with the same diagnosis are predicted to respond the same way to the same treatment.
In the last category, inter-rater reliability, two or more psychologists (or "raters"), must come to similar conclusions regarding a measurement, test, or experiment.
With internal reliability, various parts of a test or measurement must produce similar results.
